title: Board Modifier Selection Modes
description: Board selection: add replace (default) merge mode; modifier chords Ctrl=subtractive, Shift=additive, Ctrl+Shift=invertive override toolbar mode on pointer; extend WASM pointerDownScreen with ctrl/meta flag; remove shift+empty pan (middle-button pan only). Update play toolbar default to replace and add Replace control.
summary: Added BoardSelectionMode replace as default (resolve options + WASM host). Pointer chords: Ctrl/Meta=subtractive, Shift=additive, Ctrl+Shift+Meta=invertive override stored toolbar mode; merge_mode is captured on marquee drags. pick merge runs for replace/subtractive and for invertive only when modifier keys were used, so multi-node drags still work with toolbar additive/invertive unless modifiers apply. Removed shift+empty-background pan (middle button only). pointerDownScreen WASM/JS gained ctrl_or_meta. Play toolbar: Replace control (MousePointer2), default replace. Tests updated for multi-drag (additive option) plus replace/modifier coverage.
